introBody: Stories, people and places — preserved in the way they felt. We capture the quiet emotion, the unfiltered laughter, and the subtle details that turn moments into memories.
bio: Sankhadeep is an independent photographer specializing in editorial portraits, timeless weddings, intimate celebrations, and visual storytelling. With an eye for natural light and candid emotion, his work seeks to capture genuine human connection without artificial posture.
philosophy: We believe photography is about presence. When we stop trying to direct every moment, the real story reveals itself. Each photograph is a quiet document of light, emotion, and memory.
